Class PythonImportMappings

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.imports.PythonImportMappings
public final class PythonImportMappings extends Object
The curated Python modules the mappers on a class path contribute, and their resolution against a ClassIndex.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

    • fingerprint

      public String fingerprint()
      A digest of every mapping, stable across runs, which changes whenever a mapping changes. What a module resolves to also depends on the ClassIndex it is resolved against, so a cache of resolved modules keys on the class path as well.
      Returns:
      The hexadecimal digest
